title: Founded and grew Muyuan Foods into the world's largest pig-farming
statement: Founded and grew Muyuan Foods into the world's largest pig-farming and breeding operation over more than two decades.
outcome: Muyuan Foods' revenue nearly doubled from RMB 78.89 billion (2021) to RMB 144.15 billion (2025), and the company became the global leader in pig farming and breeding by volume.

title: Resigned as chairman
statement: Resigned as chairman, director, and president on June 3, 2026, transitioning to a Lifetime Honorary Chairman and research-institute role, with Cao Zhinian taking over as chairman.
outcome: The leadership transition was completed as of the June 3, 2026 announcement, with Cao Zhinian installed as chairman and Qin retaining an honorary and research-focused role.
